valueFlow.successBranch: minter -> promotion dispatcher; donationSplit% USDC -> NudgeStreamer buffer[(batchMinter, USDC)] -> batchMinter linearly. Remainder retained for pool()'s 60/30/10.

forceApprove(streamer, donationAmount) never reset to zero. Common to all four donors.

CONDITIONAL wiring hazard. BatchNFTMinterMultiToken.setNudgeTokenWhitelist rejects (BatchMint__RewardTokenIsPaymentToken) the token equal to the batchMinter's OWN pinned dispatcher's primeToken(). So the donation branch is un-wireable exactly when a donor's nudge token equals the recipient batchMinter's payment token. Expected live config (batchMinter pinned to the BalancerPooler, prime = USDS; nudge token = USDC) does NOT collide. But the collision is reachable if a batchMinter is ever pinned to a USDC-prime dispatcher. Worse: if the owner LATER repoints tokenMinter/dispatcherIndex so an already-whitelisted token becomes the payment token, batchMint SKIPS that entry at runtime -- so the streamer keeps accepting donations for that pair via collectNudge while the batchMinter's snapshot silently ignores the balance. Value accumulates un-payable. DEFERRED to interaction analysis; applies identically to Uniboost, NudgeRatchet, and BalancerPoolerV2's USDC gem.
